Let me analyze the statute and the facts to determine if Section 2(a)(2)(B) applies to Bob in 2014.

First, let me understand the facts:
- Alice and Bob got married on Feb 3rd, 1992
- Alice died on July 9th, 2014
- Alice was a nonresident alien since March 4th, 1990

Now let me look at Section 2(a)(2)(B):

From the statute, Section 2(a)(2)(B) states:
"(B) unless, for the taxpayer's taxable year during which his spouse died, a joint return could have been made. A husband and wife may make a single return jointly of income taxes, even though one of the spouses has neither gross income nor deductions, except that no joint return shall be made if either the husband or wife at any time during the taxable year is a nonresident alien."

So for Section 2(a)(2)(B) to apply (meaning Bob CAN be considered a surviving spouse), the following conditions must be met:
1. For the taxable year during which Alice died (2014), a joint return COULD have been made
